lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Hey! How are you?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Good, thank God. And you?

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Good, thanks. What’s new with you?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: ما شي يديد، كل شي زين.
lines.trans: Nothing new; everything’s good.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Alright, see you later.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Where are you going now?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: I’m going to the shop. Do you want anything?

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: إي، ييب لي ماي لو سمحت.
lines.trans: Yes, get me some water, please.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Sure. Anything else?

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: No, just water. Thanks.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: What do you want to have for dinner today?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: I want something light, not too much.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: We also have bread and cheese.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Good, let’s eat at home.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Alright, I’ll get the food ready.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: What did you do today?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: دوامي كان طويل، وتوّي راد البيت.
lines.trans: My workday was long, and I’ve only just got home.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Are you tired?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: شوي، بس لازم أرتاح قبل لا أطلع.
lines.trans: A little, but I need to rest before I go out.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: No worries, we can go out in a little while.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Are you visiting your family today?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: هيه، بكلمهم الحين وبمرّ عليهم عقب.
lines.trans: Yes, I’ll call them now and drop by later.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Who will be there?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: أخوي وربيعي، ويمكن بنت عمي بعد.
lines.trans: My brother and my friend, and maybe my cousin too.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Nice, give them my regards.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Have you finished tidying the room?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Almost, but there’s still a little left.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Want me to help you?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Yes, if you can, move these things.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: ولا يهمك، خلني أخلّص هني أول.
lines.trans: No problem, let me finish here first.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: How much is this item?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Thirty-five dirhams.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: A little expensive. Do you have something cheaper?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: عندنا واحد ثاني، بس لونه غير.
lines.trans: We have another one, but its colour is different.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: خلني أشوفه، يعني يمكن يناسبني أكثر.
lines.trans: Let me see it; I mean, maybe it’ll suit me better.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: خذ هالورقة ومرّ على المكتب اللي فوق.
lines.trans: Take this paper and stop by the office upstairs.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: سمح لي، شو يعني «مرّ على المكتب»؟
lines.trans: Sorry, what does “stop by the office” mean?

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: يعني روح للمكتب وخله يشوف الورقة.
lines.trans: It means go to the office and let them look at the paper.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Could you repeat the last part?

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: أكيد، ولا يهمك. بشرح لك شوي شوي.
lines.trans: Of course, no problem. I’ll explain it slowly.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Have you finished the report?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: للحين لا، لأن البيانات ما وصلتني.
lines.trans: Not yet, because I haven’t received the data.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: When do you expect to finish it?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: إذا وصلتني الحين، بخلّصه قبل نهاية الدوام.
lines.trans: If it reaches me now, I’ll finish it before the end of the shift.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Alright, let me know if you need anything.

lessons.title: Asking for help and making requests

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Can I ask you a question?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Of course, go ahead.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: ما أقدر أفتح هالملف. ممكن تساعدني؟
lines.trans: I can’t open this file. Could you help me?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Yes, let me look at the problem.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: يمكن تحتاج تحدّث البرنامج، عشان جي ما يفتح.
lines.trans: Maybe you need to update the program; that’s why it won’t open.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: What do you think about going out after work?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Maybe; it depends on when I finish.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: If you finish early, we’ll wait for you.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Alright, I’ll call you before I leave.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Great, let’s decide in a little while.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: What are you going to order?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Maybe I’ll get a coffee and a sandwich.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Do you want sugar in the coffee?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: لا، من غير سكر. الصراحة أحبها جي.
lines.trans: No, without sugar. Honestly, I like it this way.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: أنا بعد. بس اليوم باخذ شاي.
lines.trans: Me too. But today I’ll get tea.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Why didn’t you come to the meeting?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: ما قدرت، لأن السيارة اختربت في الدرب.
lines.trans: I couldn’t; the car broke down on the way.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: آها، عشان جي ما رديت على اتصالي؟
lines.trans: Ah, so that’s why you didn’t answer my call?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: هيه، توّي وصلت البيت وشفت اتصالك.
lines.trans: Yes, I’ve only just got home and saw your call.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: ولا يهمك، أهم شي إنك بخير.
lines.trans: No worries; the main thing is that you’re okay.

lessons.title: The word يعني in natural conversation

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: How was the place?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Nice—I mean, quiet and not crowded.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: So, would you recommend that I go?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: هيه، خصوصاً إذا تبغي مكان ترتاح فيه.
lines.trans: Yes, especially if you want somewhere to relax.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Alright, maybe I’ll go tomorrow.

lessons.title: Talking about a story or situation

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: سمعت السالفة اللي استوت في الدوام؟
lines.trans: Did you hear about what happened at work?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: No, what happened?

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: صار لخبطة في الجدول، وكل واحد راح مكان غير.
lines.trans: There was confusion with the schedule, and everyone went somewhere different.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: Really? And then what happened?

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: رتّبوا الموضوع عقب، بس خذ وقت.
lines.trans: They sorted it out later, but it took time.

lessons.title: Softening requests and suggesting a solution

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Can you send me the details today?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.trans: I’ll try, but I have a lot of work.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: إذا ما تقدر اليوم، عادي أستلمها باجر.
lines.trans: If you can’t today, it’s okay for me to receive them tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: زين، خلني أخلّص هالشغلة وبطرشها لك.
lines.trans: Alright, let me finish this task and I’ll send it to you.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Thanks, I appreciate your help.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Do you feel this plan is better?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: على حسب. إذا عندنا وقت، هي أحسن.
lines.trans: It depends. If we have time, it’s better.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: And if we don’t have time?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: نسوي الشي الضروري أول، والباقي عقب.
lines.trans: We’ll do what’s necessary first and the rest later.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: صح، جي نضمن إن أهم شي يخلص.
lines.trans: Right, this way we make sure the most important thing gets done.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: I told you not to put it here.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: أنا فهمت إنك تقصد المكان الثاني.
lines.trans: I understood that you meant the other place.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: No, I meant this exact place.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: أوكي، الحين فهمت عليك. سمح لي.
lines.trans: Okay, now I understand you. Sorry about that.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: ما عليه، تصير. خلنا نعدّل المكان وخلاص.
lines.trans: It’s alright, it happens. Let’s change the location and that’s it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: وين كنت؟ دقيت عليك قبل شوي.
lines.trans: Where were you? I called you a little while ago.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: كنت في المحل، وتوّي طالع منه.
lines.trans: I was at the shop; I’ve just come out of it.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Why didn’t you answer?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: كان المكان زحمة وما سمعت التلفون.
lines.trans: The place was crowded, and I didn’t hear the phone.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.trans: Alright, call me when you arrive.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: ها، شو صار على موضوع الوظيفة؟
lines.trans: So, what happened with the job situation?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: للحين ما في رد. يعني يمكن يردّون عليّ باجر.
lines.trans: There’s still no reply. I mean, maybe they’ll get back to me tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: إن شاء الله خير. وإذا ما ردّوا؟
lines.trans: Hopefully it works out. And if they don’t reply?

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: بنتظر شوي، وعقب بتواصل وياهم مرة ثانية.
lines.trans: I’ll wait a little, then contact them again.

lines.speaker: Speaker 1
lines.ar: زين، عسى خير. وإذا احتجت مساعدة، خبرني.
lines.trans: Alright, hope it goes well. If you need help, let me know.

lines.speaker: Speaker 2
lines.ar: تسلم، ما قصّرت. بخبرك إذا استوى شي.
lines.trans: Thanks, I appreciate it. I’ll let you know if anything happens.
